description: Complete single-owner Laya integration across Local AI Hub: expose typed shadow decisions through the existing MCP and root-authorized HTTP surfaces; collect naturally occurring useful training examples with minimum necessary raw input where it materially helps, typed state, deterministic baselines, Laya outputs, downstream outcomes, provenance, scopes, redaction, lifecycle metrics, and failures; keep human labels separate with versioned rubric and independent review; support scoped review, deletion, group-safe validation/test splits, and safe verified export. Deterministic retrieval remains authoritative; advisory activates only after measured benefit and explicit approval. Keep inference local and shadow-only during collection. Do not train, benchmark, generate cards, run synthetic inference, download/install models, or roll out until separately authorized. Verify model/provider availability and live/runtime behavior; configured routes alone are not evidence. Approved specification path: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-laya-active-decision-service-training-capture.md.

acceptance_criteria: Use the existing always-available Hub Laya service, state directory, cache, candidate store, and one Hub-managed runtime per installation; create no separate daemon.
Hub startup keeps the Laya API/service available without eagerly loading the model; absence of a resident provider session is normal.

First eligible Laya request lazily loads the pinned local checkpoint and remains resident during active work and for 600 seconds after the latest completed request; each completion resets the idle deadline.
The presence or identity of another loaded model or GPU reservation alone never suppresses Laya request handling, blocks safe lazy load, or prevents Laya idle close.

Scheduler-owned physical capacity/coexistence checks remain authoritative; unknown or insufficient physical capacity and provider/device failures return explicit unavailable without evicting or preempting other models.
Preserve the active hardware profile, CPU fallback, reservation owner identity, and reservation limits.
Keep lifecycle safe across concurrent requests, timeout, idle expiry, reload, provider-close errors, and shutdown.
Verify checkpoint presence/hash and installed compatible provider before claiming runtime availability; configuration alone is insufficient.
Do not install/download models or drivers, change CPU fallback, run synthetic inference, train, benchmark, or roll out.
task_laya_foundation.blocker: Stability reports the Hub running qwen2.5-coder:7b with inference_active, moderate VRAM pressure, and an internal GPU reservation. Laya coexistence/capacity is unproven; no safe runtime window or current Laya checkpoint/provider/source revision is verified.
task_laya_foundation.description: Hub Laya API/service remains available for the lifetime of the Hub process, independent of whether a Laya model is resident. Do not preload at Hub startup. On the first Laya request, lazily load the explicitly pinned local checkpoint; retain the provider session while work is in flight and until 600 seconds after the most recently completed Laya request, resetting the idle deadline after every completion. Another model identity or external GPU reservation alone must not reject Laya, prevent its load, or prevent idle close. Stability source audit confirms dGPU admission uses an atomic capacity lease against fresh measured free VRAM; a valid external reservation alone is not a rejection, while unknown telemetry, invalid/foreign fence, stale reservation generation, and insufficient capacity fail closed. Stability reports 34 focused capacity/co-admission tests passed, including legacy reservation, owned scheduler digest, and fail-closed cases. Never evict, preempt, unload, or reconfigure another model; preserve reservation owner identity, limits, hardware profile, and CPU fallback.
task_laya_foundation.next_action: Stability to establish safe co-admission and provide read-only checkpoint/hash/provider plus running source revision. Do not preload, infer, restart, alter GPU policy, or change another model.
task_laya_foundation.title: Udržet Laya službu trvale dostupnou s lazy load

Exclude secrets and unrelated private material; keep capture local, scoped, deletable, provenance-rich, and group-safe. Collect now; fine-tuning remains deferred.

task_laya_shadow.description: Single-owner Laya integration. Typed decisions use existing MCP and root-authorized HTTP surfaces with server-bound identity and evidence. Keep Laya shadow-only and deterministic Hub behavior authoritative. Audit eligible natural capture, provenance, lifecycle, human labels, and group-safe export. Load lazily on the first Laya request, keep loaded while requests run, and unload 600 seconds after the latest request completes. A GPU reservation or another loaded model alone does not block a request. Never evict, preempt, unload, or reconfigure another model. Preserve configured hardware profile and CPU fallback; return explicit unavailable only on true provider/device capacity failure. Collect useful raw task input and relevant excerpts with redaction when they materially aid training. No installs, training, benchmark, synthetic inference, cards, or rollout.
